quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a restaurant recommendation app that asks how you feel before suggesting anywhere.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell it how you're feeling, and it matches you with a restaurant that truly fits the moment.
quests.hint: Open with the mood-matching idea before you mention restaurants at all.
quests.explanation: Matching food to mood stands out in a market full of ordinary location-based apps.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an online marketplace for second-hand children's clothing.
quests.correctAnswer: Buy and sell the clothes your kids have already outgrown - save money and keep good clothing out of landfill.
quests.hint: Pair the money saved with the waste avoided.
quests.explanation: Combining a financial saving with an environmental benefit is hard for any parent to argue with.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a parking spot rental app connecting homeowners with drivers.
quests.correctAnswer: Homeowners earn from an empty driveway, and drivers finally escape the daily parking nightmare.
quests.hint: Give equal weight to both sides of the deal.
quests.explanation: A two-sided pitch works best when both sides hear their own benefit stated clearly.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an on-demand home cleaning service that can be booked in under a minute.
quests.correctAnswer: Book a vetted local cleaner in sixty seconds - faster than writing an email.
quests.hint: Pair the speed with the trust of vetting.
quests.explanation: Speed plus vetting answers the two biggest doubts people have about home cleaning services.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box delivering locally made artisan products every month.
quests.correctAnswer: Every month, a box of handpicked goods arrives straight from makers in your own region.
quests.hint: Highlight local discovery and the sense of community.
quests.explanation: Supporting local makers gives subscribers a sense of meaning behind every purchase.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a mobile car washing service that comes to your workplace while you work.
quests.correctAnswer: Leave your desk in the evening to a spotless car - we wash it while you work.
quests.hint: Make zero time investment the whole point.
quests.explanation: Removing the need to spend personal time on an errand appeals to any busy professional.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Seasonal blooms arrive weekly, straight from local farms - fresher than anything a shop can offer.
quests.hint: Highlight the freshness that comes from local sourcing.
quests.explanation: Pairing local sourcing with regular delivery gives the subscription genuine quality credentials.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a book subscription service that matches titles to your specific personality.
quests.correctAnswer: No more choosing wrong - every book is picked to match your exact taste.
quests.hint: Lead with the problem this solves: giving up halfway through a bad pick.
quests.explanation: Personalised recommendations solve the choice overload that makes ordinary book clubs feel random.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a healthy snack subscription box curated by nutritionists for busy families.
quests.correctAnswer: Every snack is nutritionist-approved, so the whole family can enjoy the box guilt-free.
quests.hint: Combine health credentials with family-wide appeal.
quests.explanation: Expert approval eases parental guilt and positions the box above ordinary snack boxes.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that splits a restaurant bill between friends in seconds.
quests.correctAnswer: Snap the receipt, and the app splits it fairly between everyone at the table.
quests.hint: Focus on how quickly the awkward maths disappears.
quests.explanation: Removing an awkward social moment is a benefit everyone at the table can picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a plant-based meal kit designed for people who are new to cooking.
quests.correctAnswer: Every kit comes with simple steps, so even a first-time cook gets it right.
quests.hint: Speak directly to someone who has never cooked before.
quests.explanation: Naming the exact audience - beginners - removes the fear that often stops people trying.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood tool-lending library where residents borrow instead of buy.
quests.correctAnswer: Borrow a drill for one job instead of buying one you'll use twice.
quests.hint: Contrast borrowing once with buying something rarely used.
quests.explanation: A clear buy-versus-borrow contrast makes the saving obvious without needing any numbers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a laundry pickup and delivery app for busy city dwellers.
quests.correctAnswer: Drop your laundry bag outside, and it comes back washed, folded, and ready by evening.
quests.hint: Walk through the simple before-and-after in one line.
quests.explanation: A short before-and-after picture lets the listener see the whole service in seconds.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home plant subscription that sends a new easy-care plant every season.
quests.correctAnswer: A new plant arrives each season, already chosen to survive in your home.
quests.hint: Address the fear of killing houseplants directly.
quests.explanation: Removing the fear of failure is what turns a plant lover into a buyer.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app that alerts you when local shops discount unsold food.
quests.correctAnswer: Get an alert the moment your favourite bakery discounts today's unsold bread.
quests.hint: Use one specific, everyday example instead of speaking generally.
quests.explanation: A single concrete example is easier to picture than a general promise about savings.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a moving-day app that matches you with local students who need extra cash.
quests.correctAnswer: Hire nearby students by the hour, so moving day costs less and finishes faster.
quests.hint: Pair the lower cost with the added speed.
quests.explanation: Stacking two benefits - cheaper and faster - in one line makes the pitch efficient.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a babysitting app that only lists sitters verified by other local parents.
quests.correctAnswer: Every sitter is recommended by a parent nearby, so you can finally trust who you book.
quests.hint: Speak to the trust a parent needs before leaving a child with anyone.
quests.explanation: Trust is the single biggest barrier in childcare, so naming it directly builds confidence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a weekend allotment-sharing app connecting new gardeners with spare garden space.
quests.correctAnswer: Borrow a corner of someone's garden and finally grow your own vegetables this summer.

quests.explanation: Turning a long-held wish into something available this summer creates real urgency.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Swap homes with a family abroad, and holiday somewhere new without paying for a room.
quests.hint: Lead with the free accommodation as the headline saving.
quests.explanation: A concrete saving - no hotel bill - makes an unfamiliar idea feel worth trying.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a mobile bike repair service that comes to your home or office.
quests.correctAnswer: A mechanic comes to you, so a flat tyre never means a day without your bike.
quests.hint: Picture the one moment this service saves - a flat tyre.
quests.explanation: Focusing on a single relatable moment makes the whole service easy to picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: See what neighbours have shared today, and stop good food from going to waste.

quests.explanation: Framing the app around a shared community habit makes it feel warm, not transactional.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.explanation: Removing a small daily guess is a benefit any pet owner instantly understands.

quests.correctAnswer: It watches your tyre pressure and warns you before a small problem becomes a dangerous one.

quests.explanation: Connecting a small alert to a real safety risk makes the product feel worth having.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a card game designed to help distant grandparents and grandchildren bond over video calls.
quests.correctAnswer: Play a few rounds together on a video call, and distance stops feeling like distance.
quests.hint: Lead with the emotional gap this closes.
quests.explanation: Naming the emotional gap - distance - gives a simple game genuine meaning.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that shows how long the queue is at your gym in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Check the queue before you leave home, and never waste a trip to a packed gym.

quests.explanation: Naming a specific wasted trip makes an abstract feature feel worth checking every day.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Wrap your gift beautifully in reusable fabric, then just send it back for someone else's gift.

quests.prompt: Pitch a local errand-running app connecting busy professionals with trusted helpers nearby.
quests.correctAnswer: Hand off your errands to someone trusted nearby, and get your evening back.
quests.hint: Sell the free time, not the errand-running itself.
quests.explanation: People buy the time they get back, not the task being completed for them.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a monthly box that sends a new hobby kit for people bored of screens.
quests.correctAnswer: Swap one evening of scrolling for a brand-new hobby, delivered to your door each month.
quests.hint: Contrast the old habit with the new one directly.
quests.explanation: A direct swap - old habit for new - is an easy trade for anyone to picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that lets you split a streaming subscription fairly with friends automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: It splits the bill automatically, so no one has to chase a friend for money again.
quests.hint: Name the awkward moment this app removes.
quests.explanation: Removing an awkward social task is a small but genuinely persuasive everyday benefit.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app that connects dog owners for shared daily walks.
quests.correctAnswer: Match with a nearby dog owner, and turn a daily walk into a shared habit.

quests.explanation: Adding a social benefit to a solo chore makes the pitch feel richer and warmer.
